title: 提取行李与行李丢失
goal: 找到行李转盘；行李没到或损坏时，会描述行李、留联系方式、要求送到酒店。
tips: 离开行李提取区之前就去 Lost Baggage / Baggage Services 柜台登记，出了海关再回来就麻烦了。
保留行李牌（baggage tag，通常贴在登机牌或护照背面），登记时要用。
描述行李按“大小 + 颜色 + 特征”：a large black suitcase with a red ribbon on the handle。

exchanges.hear: Bags from your flight are on carousel five.
exchanges.hearZh: 您航班的行李在5号转盘。

exchanges.reply: Yes. My suitcase didn't come out.
exchanges.replyZh: 是的，我的行李箱没出来。

exchanges.hear: Do you have your baggage tag?
exchanges.reply: Yes, it's on the back of my boarding pass.

exchanges.hearZh: 您能描述一下您的包吗？
exchanges.reply: It's a large black suitcase with four wheels.
exchanges.replyZh: 是一个黑色的大行李箱，有四个轮子。

exchanges.hear: Is there a name tag on it?
exchanges.reply: Yes, my name and phone number are on it.
exchanges.replyZh: 有，上面有我的名字和电话。

exchanges.reply: To my hotel, please. Here's the address.
exchanges.replyZh: 请送到我的酒店。这是地址。

exchanges.hear: We'll call you when we find it.
exchanges.hearZh: 找到后我们会给您打电话。

exchanges.reply: One of the wheels is broken.

dialogue.title: 在行李服务柜台登记丢失

lines.en: Excuse me. My suitcase didn't come out. I was on flight UA eight five eight.
lines.zh: 打扰一下。我的行李箱没出来。我坐的是UA858航班。

lines.en: I'm sorry. Can I see your baggage tag?
lines.zh: 很抱歉。能看一下您的行李牌吗？

lines.en: Thank you. Can you describe the bag?
lines.zh: 谢谢。您能描述一下行李吗？

lines.en: It's a medium-size blue suitcase. There's a red ribbon on the handle.
lines.zh: 一个蓝色的中号行李箱，拉杆上系着一根红丝带。

lines.en: OK. It looks like your bag is still in San Francisco. It'll come on the next flight.
lines.zh: 好的。看起来您的行李还在旧金山，会搭下一班飞机过来。

lines.en: Tomorrow morning. Where should we deliver it?
lines.zh: 明天上午。我们送到哪里？

lines.en: To the Marriott Hotel on Fifth Avenue. Here's my phone number.
lines.zh: 第五大道的万豪酒店。这是我的电话号码。

lines.en: Great. We'll call you before delivery. Please fill out this form.
lines.zh: 好的。送之前我们会给您打电话。请填一下这张表。
